A '''moon''' [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genassa/Legends|Genassa]] of the [[M'shinni sector/Legends|M'shinni sector]]. At one point, Genassa's [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[M'shinn]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] the moon. Subsequently, the M'shinni expanded beyond the [[Genassa system/Legends|Genassa system]], which was in turn incorporated into several [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] states.

==Description==
A large moon [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]]<ref name="GG12" /> the terrestrial<ref name="Mask">''[[Mask of the Pirate Queen]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|330|Genassa}}</ref> [[Genassa/Legends|Genassa]].<ref name="GG12" /> It was situated in the [[Genassa system/Legends|Genassa system]], a part of the [[M'shinni sector/Legends|M'shinni sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
[[File:Mshinni.jpg|thumb|right|180px|The M'shinn species colonized Genassa's moon.]]
At some point, Genassa's [[Plant/Legends|plant]]-covered, [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[M'shinn]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] the [[Moon/Legends|moon]], subsequently going on to [[Terraforming/Legends|terraform]] the rest of the Genassa [[Star system/Legends|system's]] planets and,<ref name="GG12" /> at some point by [[3966 BBY/Legends|3966 BBY]],<ref name="MshinniInterstellar">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]'' establishes that the [[Skrilling/Legends|Skrillings]] first travel off-world after the [[M'shinn]]i had [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Agriworld-2079/Legends|Agriworld-2079]]&mdash;which ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places in a [[Agriworld-2079 system/Legends|star system]] other than the [[Genassa system/Legends|Genassa system]]. The ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'' establishes that [[Jervo Thalien]]&mdash;whom [[Knights of the Old Republic 1|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 1]] depicts as a Skrilling&mdash;was [[Chairman/Legends|chairman]] of the off-world company [[Lhosan Industries]] by the time [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] became a member [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Since ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' dates the latter event to [[3966 BBY/Legends|3966 BBY]], the M'shinni must have therefore acquired interstellar travel ability at some point by that date.</ref> traveled to other [[Star/Legends|star]] systems.<ref name="GG12" />

Space surrounding the Genassa system was explored by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] between [[3000 BBY]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], and along with the rest of its star system, Genassa's moon fell within the borders of the Republic by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEA" /> By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], the system was incorporated into the territory of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and it was a part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[13 ABY/Legends|thirty years]] later.<ref name="EGTW" /> The population of the Genassa system around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] numbered between one and ten billion, and [[27 ABY/Legends|two years]] later, it had been conquered by the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] species as part of its [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system remained under the invaders' control until [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Genassa's moon was mentioned in the [[1995]] [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]'', in an entry authored by [[Lisa Smedman]].<ref name="GG12" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] placed the Genassa system, and therefore the moon, in grid square M-7. In the book, a number of [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] maps depict Genassa between the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel]] and [[Ottega system/Legends|Ottega systems]] on the [[Celanon Spur/Legends|Celanon Spur]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]].<ref name="TEA" /> That placement was later repeated in several maps in other sources.<ref name="EGTW" /><ref name="EotECR">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref><ref name="FF">''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File Collector's Guide & Galaxy Chart]]''</ref><ref name="Podracing">{{SW|url=news/this-is-podracing-sports-in-the-star-wars-galaxy-part-1|series=Sports in the Star Wars Galaxy|text=Part 1: This Is Podracing|nolive=1}}</ref><ref name="AoRCR">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref><ref name="FDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

[[File:GenassaOnCelanonSpur-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A number of maps of the galaxy published in several ''Star Wars'' sources placed Genassa, and therefore its moon, on the Celanon Spur.]]
However, in a map of ''The Essential Atlas'' focusing on Genassa's galactic region, the Mid Rim, its star system is instead placed a relatively short distance off that segment of the Celanon Spur<ref name="TEA" />&mdash;a placement that was also repeated in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the book<ref name="Mid Rim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}}</ref> as well as in a smaller-scale map in Jason Fry and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]'s [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' focusing on Genassa's galactic neighborhood. This article assumes that the placement originating from these latter, more specific maps is correct.<ref name="EGTW" />
